content:
Mathlib now has an official sublibrary for additive combinatorics! See AddCombi here: https://github.com/leanprover-community/add-combi.

This new library is intended to become the main additive combinatorics library downstream of mathlib and to act as a staging ground for upstreaming relevant results to mathlib. It is already used by APAP and PFR.

AddCombi currently contains a single result: the Balog-Szemerédi-Gowers theorem, a fundamental tool in additive combinatorics. In the near future, we will also upstream:

  • from APAP, the Marcinkiewicz-Zygmund inequality, the compact convolution, the compact Fourier transform, Rudin's inequality, Chang's lemma, Bohr sets...
  • from PFR, the (entropic) Ruzsa calculus.

The inaugural maintainers are @Bhavik Mehta and myself.
